movie.title: Bagarre
movie.overview: Naïm is a sweetheart in everyday life but a beast when it comes to fighting. To afford treatment for his aging dog, he's forced to join "Hello Brawl", a service of street fighters resolving conflicts with punches.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To pay for his aging dog's medical treatment, a gentle everyday man unleashes his fierce combat skills by joining a street-fighting app that resolves everyday disputes with fists.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Naïm is a soft-spoken, kindhearted man in his day-to-day life, but he possesses an undeniable talent for fighting when pushed into the ring. When his beloved aging dog requires costly medical care, Naïm is forced to look for quick cash through unconventional means. He reluctantly joins 'Hello Brawl', a controversial service where street fighters are hired to settle personal conflicts with their fists. As he balances his gentle nature with brutal street brawls, Naïm must navigate comedic chaos and emotional stakes to save his companion.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Naïm lives a quiet, unassuming life, well-known by those around him as a gentle and sweetheart of a person. However, beneath his calm exterior lies an extraordinary, almost instinctual talent for fighting that he prefers to keep hidden. His peaceful routine comes to a sudden halt when his elderly dog falls severely ill, requiring an expensive medical treatment that Naïm simply cannot afford. Desperate for a rapid source of income, Naïm stumbles upon 'Hello Brawl', an underground gig-economy service where citizens hire fighters to resolve their everyday disputes through physical brawls. Recognizing that his innate combat skills are his only asset capable of raising the cash in time, he reluctantly signs up as a hired fighter. As Naïm takes on increasingly bizarre and humorous assignments, he finds himself clashing with eccentric clients, rival fighters, and absurd interpersonal conflicts. Despite the violence required by his new job, Naïm fights with a sense of reluctant duty, holding onto his core empathy even while knocking out opponents. The job tests both his physical endurance and his moral limits, forcing him to keep his brutal underground life secret from those he cares about. Ultimately, Naïm's deep devotion to his loyal dog drives him to overcome the toughest brawlers in the network, proving how far he will go for family.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Bagarre is a blend of comedy and drama that follows Naïm, an extraordinarily kind-hearted man who leads a simple life anchored by his devotion to his aging dog. Beneath his quiet and gentle demeanor, Naïm harbors a formidable talent for combat, a skill he rarely uses and prefers to keep secret. When his dog develops a serious medical condition requiring costly veterinary care, Naïm's financial constraints push him to desperation. In search of quick money, he discovers 'Hello Brawl', a unique street-fighting service where people hire brawlers to settle personal grievances with brute force. Striking a delicate balance between his gentle nature and the violent world of gig-economy street fighting, Naïm takes on a series of outlandish conflicts to earn the funds needed for his dog's treatment. The narrative balances lighthearted comedy derived from absurd fighting scenarios with heartfelt drama centered on unconditional loyalty and love.

story_structure.introduction: Naïm is introduced as a gentle soul who shares a deep bond with his aging dog. When his pet faces a costly health crisis, Naïm is forced to balance his compassionate nature with his hidden, formidable fighting skills.
story_structure.risingAction: As Naïm takes on increasingly intense and volatile combat assignments, he earns money for the treatment while navigating the escalating violence of the street-fighting underworld and questioning his moral boundaries.
